stories.title: Growing up in Flintshire: what new social mobility data shows
stories.summary: Flintshire is in the lower band of UK council areas for young people’s job opportunities and for the conditions children grow up in, new figures from the Social Mobility Commission show. stories.title: Police appeal for witnesses after man suffers life-threatening injuries on A55 slip road at St Asaph
stories.summary: North Wales Police are appealing for witnesses after a man suffered life-threatening injuries in a collision on the A55 at St Asaph this morning. Two cars were involved in a minor collision on the westbound slip road at junction 27 at about 7am on Wednesday, 25 November, and the drivers got out of their vehicles.

stories.title: Countess of Chester AE under very high demand, hospital trust says
stories.summary: The Countess of Chester Hospital is asking patients to keep its AE department for emergencies, as demand stays very high. The Countess of Chester Hospital NHS Foundation Trust says its AE continues to experience very high levels of demand.
